findings.title: Shutdown can block forever waiting for ListenAndServe after timeout
findings.evidence: After Shutdown times out, the code logs and calls Close, but then still performs a blocking receive from errCh with no timeout or fallback. If the server goroutine does not deliver promptly, the process remains stuck in shutdown despite the 15s deadline.
findings.recommendation: Do not block indefinitely on errCh after the shutdown deadline. Either return immediately after Close, or wait for errCh with a separate bounded select using the existing shutdown context or another short timeout, then exit regardless.
